description: Felling of a Sycamore Tree in the rear garden subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/6/12/73 (T19).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to fell the Sycamore Tree (T19), subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/6/12/73, shall comprise only the following and must be carried out in accordance with British Standard BS3998:2010:

- Felling of a Sycamore Tree in the rear garden subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/6/12/73 (T19).

In accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 2 - No less than five working days' notice shall be given to the Council's Aboricultural Officer before any work commences to the tree (Telephone 020 8748 3020). 

In order that the Council has the opportunity to ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with Condition 1, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 3 - Prior to the planting of the replacement tree, details of the replacement tree (including species, height, maturity and location) shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The replacement tree shall thereafter be planted within the next available planting season following the completion of the development hereby approved. If the replacement tree is severely damaged, dying or seriously diseased within 5 years of planting, then this shall be replaced with a tree of similar size and species to that originally required to be planted in the next appropriate planting season.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
